DOCKER_PLATFORM:
- linux/amd64
c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.28'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cuda_compiler:
- cuda-nvcc
cuda_compiler_version:
- '12.9'
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10
pin_run_as_build:
  python:
    min_pin: x.x
    max_pin: x.x
python:
- 3.11.* *_cpython
- 3.12.* *_cpython
- 3.13.* *_cp313
- 3.14.* *_cp314
target_platform:
- linux-64
xz:
- '5'
zip_keys:
- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version
  - c_stdlib_version
  - cuda_compiler_version

about.description:
A Python native interface for writing high-performance CUDA kernels based on
core CUTLASS and CuTe concepts without any performance compromises. This allows for
a much smoother learning curve, orders of magnitude faster compile times,
native integration with DL frameworks without writing glue code and much more
intuitive meta-programming that does not require deep C++ expertise.

This feedstock builds the Python package, the CUTLASS DSL runtime shared
library, and the development and static-library packages for building C/C++
against that runtime.
about.summary: A Python native interface for writing high-performance CUDA kernels based on core CUTLASS and CuTe concepts without any performance compromises.

about.description:
The shared library that GPU kernels JIT-compiled by the CUTLASS DSL load
at run time. It ships neither headers nor Python code, and is
pulled in as a dependency rather than installed directly: install
libcute-dsl-runtime-dev to build C/C++ against it, or nvidia-cutlass-dsl
to use it from Python.
about.summary: Runtime shared library for the CUTLASS DSL.

about.description:
The C header and cross-compile link stubs needed to build C/C++ code
against libcute-dsl-runtime.
about.summary: Development files for building against the CUTLASS DSL runtime.

about.description:
The CUDA dialect shim that DSL-generated code calls into, as a static
archive to link into your own binary
about.summary: Static library for the CUTLASS DSL CUDA dialect shim.

about.description:
A Python native interface for writing high-performance CUDA kernels based on
core CUTLASS and CuTe concepts without any performance compromises. This allows for
a much smoother learning curve, orders of magnitude faster compile times,
native integration with DL frameworks without writing glue code and much more
intuitive meta-programming that does not require deep C++ expertise.
It also pulls in libcute-dsl-runtime-dev and libcute-dsl-runtime-static,
so one environment covers both using the DSL from Python and building
C/C++ against the runtime. Install those two on their own for the
C/C++ use case without Python.
about.summary: A Python native interface for writing high-performance CUDA kernels based on core CUTLASS and CuTe concepts without any performance compromises.

name: nvidia-cutlass-dsl-split
raw_meta_yaml:
# Free-threaded CPython (3.14t) is not supported yet: protobuf publishes no
# 3.14t packages. It will be enabled once it does

{% set name = "nvidia_cutlass_dsl" %}
{% set version = "4.8.0" %}
{% set arm_variant_type = arm_variant_type | default("sbsa") %}
{% set cuda_compiler_version = cuda_compiler_version | default("None") %}
{% set cuda_major = cuda_compiler_version.split(".")[0] %}
# The wheel layout carries a cu12 and a cu13 directory side by side; only the
# one matching this build gets any files.
{% set cuda_major_other = "13" if cuda_major == "12" else "12" %}
{% set platform = "linux-x86_64" %}  # [linux64]
{% set platform = "linux-sbsa" %}  # [aarch64]
{% set platform = "windows-x86_64" %}  # [win64]
{% set extension = "tar.xz" %}  # [not win]
{% set extension = "zip" %}  # [win]

# Runtime dependency bounds, mirroring the wheel's Requires-Dist metadata.
{% set typing_extensions_min = "4.10" %}
{% set cuda_bindings_min = "12.8" %}
{% set protobuf_min = "4.21.12" %}

# 3.14 and 3.14t both report py == 314; the `python` variant carries the ABI
# build string (`3.14.* *_cp314t`)
# Un-comment below to enable 3.14t builds.
# {% set py_tag = py ~ ("t" if (python | default("")).endswith("t") else "") %}
{% set py_tag = py %}

package:
  name: nvidia-cutlass-dsl-split
  version: {{ version }}

source:
  - url: "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-cutlass-dsl/redist/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/linux-x86_64/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-linux-x86_64-{{ version }}_cuda12-archive.tar.xz"  # [linux and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12")]
    sha256: "343cfdfa3a019c1beaef1577bef85da37cb50cd3be6dbb472f4c34a1f51b6099"  # [linux and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12")]
  - url: "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-cutlass-dsl/redist/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/linux-x86_64/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-linux-x86_64-{{ version }}_cuda13-archive.tar.xz"  # [linux and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("13")]
    sha256: "14c724e5e46df9bd49bc788b5f4fef44d187709ba5ee8f1c3876fc8e53aaabaa"  # [linux and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("13")]
  - url: "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-cutlass-dsl/redist/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/linux-sbsa/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-linux-sbsa-{{ version }}_cuda12-archive.tar.xz"  # [linux and aarch64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12") and arm_variant_type == "sbsa"]
    sha256: "40c1bcd9cb1e13cffa271425c6c572146a3e1a50a3f137bce2f9b14d6def3813"  # [linux and aarch64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12") and arm_variant_type == "sbsa"]
  - url: "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-cutlass-dsl/redist/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/linux-sbsa/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-linux-sbsa-{{ version }}_cuda13-archive.tar.xz"  # [linux and aarch64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("13") and arm_variant_type == "sbsa"]
    sha256: "51368813db1a90f37a0f51c12d673effebc0f6c240f7995693bc44f019d16e31"  # [linux and aarch64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("13") and arm_variant_type == "sbsa"]
  - url: "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-cutlass-dsl/redist/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/windows-x86_64/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-windows-x86_64-{{ version }}_cuda12-archive.zip"  # [win and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12")]
    sha256: "552f6a16caf763aefbf01b4a56c7d25cd0bcb7cbc53cd522c844fa151d65ba54"  # [win and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("12")]
  - url: "https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/nvidia-cutlass-dsl/redist/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/windows-x86_64/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-windows-x86_64-{{ version }}_cuda13-archive.zip"  # [win and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("13")]
    sha256: "2c738eeeac960e0ac11c4f269b937d8b5414cd7c07713fb2cd145efbc2b0bcb7"  # [win and x86_64 and (cuda_compiler_version or "").startswith("13")]

build:
  number: 0
  skip: true  # [not (linux64 or aarch64 or win64) or cuda_compiler_version in ("None", "")]

requirements:
  build:
    - cf-nvidia-tools 1.*   # [linux]
    - {{ stdlib("c") }}
  host:
    - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}

outputs:

  # The runtime lib that JIT-compiled kernels dlopen; one per CTK
  - name: libcute-dsl-runtime
    build:
      ignore_run_exports:
        - cuda-version
    files:
      - lib/libcute_dsl_runtime.so          # [linux]
      - Library/bin/cute_dsl_runtime.dll    # [win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", min_pin="x", max_pin="x") }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libcute_dsl_runtime.so                      # [linux]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\\cute_dsl_runtime.dll exit 1         # [win]
    about:
      home: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/
      license: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-End-User-License-Agreement
      license_file: LICENSE
      license_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/pythonDSL/license.html
      summary: Runtime shared library for the CUTLASS DSL.
      description: |
        The shared library that GPU kernels JIT-compiled by the CUTLASS DSL load
        at run time. It ships neither headers nor Python code, and is
        pulled in as a dependency rather than installed directly: install
        libcute-dsl-runtime-dev to build C/C++ against it, or nvidia-cutlass-dsl
        to use it from Python.
      doc_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/

  # Header/cross-link stubs to build C/C++ against the runtime lib. Also one per CTK.
  - name: libcute-dsl-runtime-dev
    build:
      ignore_run_exports:
        - cuda-version
      run_exports:
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime", max_pin="x.x") }}
    files:
      - include/CuteDSLRuntime.h            # [linux]
      - lib/stubs                           # [linux]
      - Library/include/CuteDSLRuntime.h    # [win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", min_pin="x", max_pin="x") }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime", exact=True) }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/CuteDSLRuntime.h                # [linux]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\\CuteDSLRuntime.h exit 1     # [win]
        # Cross-compile link stubs target aarch64 only,
        # so only the linux-x86_64 redist archive ships them
        - test -d $PREFIX/lib/stubs                               # [linux64]
    about:
      home: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/
      license: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-End-User-License-Agreement
      license_file: LICENSE
      license_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/pythonDSL/license.html
      summary: Development files for building against the CUTLASS DSL runtime.
      description: |
        The C header and cross-compile link stubs needed to build C/C++ code
        against libcute-dsl-runtime.
      doc_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/

  # The CUDA dialect shim as a static archive; one per CTK
  - name: libcute-dsl-runtime-static
    build:
      ignore_run_exports:
        - cuda-version
    files:
      - lib/libcuda_dialect_runtime_static.a          # [linux]
      - Library/lib/cuda_dialect_runtime_static.lib   # [win]
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}
      run:
        - {{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", min_pin="x", max_pin="x") }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime-dev", exact=True) }}
    test:
      commands:
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libcuda_dialect_runtime_static.a                # [linux]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\\cuda_dialect_runtime_static.lib exit 1  # [win]
        # Pulled in via the -dev dependency
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/CuteDSLRuntime.h                            # [linux]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\\CuteDSLRuntime.h exit 1                 # [win]
    about:
      home: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/
      license: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-End-User-License-Agreement
      license_file: LICENSE
      license_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/pythonDSL/license.html
      summary: Static library for the CUTLASS DSL CUDA dialect shim.
      description: |
        The CUDA dialect shim that DSL-generated code calls into, as a static
        archive to link into your own binary
      doc_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/

  # Python code + the CPython-ABI-specific extension module; one per python and CTK.
  - name: nvidia-cutlass-dsl
    script: install_cutlass_dsl.sh   # [not win]
    script: install_cutlass_dsl.bat  # [win]
    build:
      string: "py{{ py_tag }}h{{ PKG_HASH }}_{{ PKG_BUILDNUM }}"
      missing_dso_whitelist:
        - "*libcuda.so*"              # driver, not provided by any conda package
      ignore_run_exports:
        - cuda-version
    requirements:
      build:
        - {{ compiler('c') }}
        - {{ compiler('cuda') }}
        - {{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - {{ stdlib("c") }}
      host:
        - python
        - cuda-version {{ cuda_compiler_version }}
        # Everything under cu{{ cuda_major }} is a symlink into $PREFIX/lib and $PREFIX/include,
        # so the real files have to be unpacked here for the links to resolve
        # while this output is being built. On Windows the entries are copies
        # of these same files, so they have to be here to be copied.
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime", exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime-dev", exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime-static", exact=True) }}
      run:
        - python
        # Python 3.11 and above have the `strenum` module built-in
        - backports.strenum  # [py<311]
        - typing-extensions >={{ typing_extensions_min }}
        - cuda-bindings >={{ cuda_bindings_min }}
        - protobuf >={{ protobuf_min }}
        # Provides the `tvm_ffi` module used by the TVM-FFI interop paths.
        # load_module() → ctypes.CDLL → dlopen
        - apache-tvm-ffi
        - {{ pin_compatible("cuda-version", min_pin="x", max_pin="x") }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime", exact=True) }}
        # Installing this package covers the C/C++ use case as well as the
        # Python one, so that a user who needs both gets them in one step. The
        # C/C++ use case on its own is libcute-dsl-runtime-dev and
        # libcute-dsl-runtime-static without this package.
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime-dev", exact=True) }}
        - {{ pin_subpackage("libcute-dsl-runtime-static", exact=True) }}
      run_constrained:
        # Optional: only needed to disassemble the cubins when needed
        - cuda-nvdisasm
    test:
      requires:
        - pip
      imports:
        - cutlass
        # The Windows redist archive does not ship iket.
        - iket  # [linux]
      commands:
        # The dist-info from the redist archive is what downstream `pip check` looks for.
        - test -f $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl-{{ version }}.dist-info/METADATA                         # [linux]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl-{{ version }}.dist-info\\METADATA exit 1          # [win]
        - python -c "import importlib.metadata as m; assert m.version('nvidia-cutlass-dsl') == '{{ version }}'"
        - pip show nvidia-cutlass-dsl
        # The .pth file is what makes the imports above resolve out of
        # nvidia_cutlass_dsl/dsl_packages.
        - test -f $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl_packages.pth                                              # [linux]
        - test -d $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/dsl_packages/cutlass                                      # [linux]
        - test -d $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/dsl_packages/iket                                         # [linux]
        - test -f $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/cu{{ cuda_major }}/lib/libcute_dsl_runtime.so             # [linux]
        - test -f $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/cu{{ cuda_major }}/lib/libcuda_dialect_runtime_static.a   # [linux]
        - test -f $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/cu{{ cuda_major }}/include/CuteDSLRuntime.h               # [linux]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl_packages.pth exit 1                                                  # [win]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl\\dsl_packages\\cutlass\\__init__.py exit 1                           # [win]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl\\cu{{ cuda_major }}\\lib\\cute_dsl_runtime.dll exit 1                # [win]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl\\cu{{ cuda_major }}\\lib\\cuda_dialect_runtime_static.lib exit 1     # [win]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl\\cu{{ cuda_major }}\\include\\CuteDSLRuntime.h exit 1                # [win]
        # Cross-compile link stubs target aarch64 only,
        # so only the linux-x86_64 redist archive ships them
        - test -d $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/cu{{ cuda_major }}/lib/stubs   # [linux64]
        - test -f $SP_DIR/nvidia_cutlass_dsl/cu{{ cuda_major_other }}/README.txt                       # [linux]
        - if not exist %SP_DIR%\\nvidia_cutlass_dsl\\cu{{ cuda_major_other }}\\README.txt exit 1       # [win]
        # Installing this package has to bring the C/C++ use case with it.
        - test -f $PREFIX/include/CuteDSLRuntime.h                                   # [linux]
        - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libcuda_dialect_runtime_static.a                       # [linux]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\\CuteDSLRuntime.h exit 1                        # [win]
        - if not exist %LIBRARY_LIB%\\cuda_dialect_runtime_static.lib exit 1         # [win]
    about:
      home: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/
      license: LicenseRef-NVIDIA-End-User-License-Agreement
      license_file: LICENSE
      license_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/media/docs/pythonDSL/license.html
      summary: A Python native interface for writing high-performance CUDA kernels based on core CUTLASS and CuTe concepts without any performance compromises.
      description: |
        A Python native interface for writing high-performance CUDA kernels based on
        core CUTLASS and CuTe concepts without any performance compromises. This allows for
        a much smoother learning curve, orders of magnitude faster compile times,
        native integration with DL frameworks without writing glue code and much more
        intuitive meta-programming that does not require deep C++ expertise.
        It also pulls in libcute-dsl-runtime-dev and libcute-dsl-runtime-static,
        so one environment covers both using the DSL from Python and building
        C/C++ against the runtime. Install those two on their own for the
        C/C++ use case without Python.
      doc_url: https://docs.nvidia.com/cutlass/latest/
